push.title: L 0-2 vs Cuc United | You: 6.6 (4th worst match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.6, your 4th worst match performance. I believe in you as much as I did this morning.

DID WELL
+ 6 tackles attempted. You did the dirty work nobody claps for. Well, I'm clapping.
+ 2 key passes. That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.

WORK ON
- Won 1 of 6 tackles (down from your usual 29%). Back to basics: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. Trust the work.
- 54% passing (7 of 13). Little homework: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- 0.8 below your typical game. That's an outlier, not an identity.
- Your 4th worst match performance at 6.6. Chin up.
- 0-2 to Cuc United. We'll come back stronger.

Coach's drill: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Hey, tuxedo_slide. You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

On to the next one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 0-2 vs Cuc United | You: 6.3 (4th worst match performance)
push.body:
A 6.3, BellyTb1. It stings. That sting means you care, and caring's half the battle.

DID WELL
+ Gave us 92 minutes. Grateful.

WORK ON
- Only 12 passes (down from your usual 16). Lesson of the day: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option. You'll thank me later.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Quick one: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. That's the whole secret.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. Here's the deal: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out. Simple as Sunday.
- You and buddskees both need a tune-up on defensive work rate. Do it together: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 1.4 under your norm. Let's figure out why and fix it.

Kickabout task: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

Brick by brick. - Coach Lasso
